description: This file defines a report parser class for auction totals in an Odoo/OpenERP module, including methods for retrieving auction data and statistics.

classes.name: auction_total_rml
classes.description: A report parser class for generating auction total reports, with methods to fetch auction data and statistics.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and updates local context with helper methods and data.

methods.name: get_auc_detail
methods.description: Retrieves auction details and associated dates for given auction lots.

methods.name: sum_taxes
methods.description: Counts auction lots for a specific auction.

methods.name: sold_item
methods.description: Counts unsold auction lots for a given object ID.

methods.name: sum_buyer
methods.description: Counts buyers associated with an auction.

methods.name: sum_seller
methods.description: Counts distinct sellers for an auction.

methods.name: sum_adj
methods.description: Sums the object prices for an auction.

methods.name: count_take
methods.description: Counts auction lots with 'ach_emp' marked as True.

methods.name: chek_paid
methods.description: Counts auction lots marked as paid or OK.

methods.name: check_paid_seller
methods.description: Sums seller prices for lots not marked as paid.

methods.name: sum_credit
methods.description: Sums buyer prices for an auction.

methods.name: sum_debit_buyer
methods.description: Sums buyer prices for an auction, defaulting to 0 if null.

methods.name: sum_debit
methods.description: Sums seller prices for a given object ID.

methods.name: sum_credit_seller
methods.description: Sums seller prices for auction lots.
